headword: {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}
gloss: direction of travel; direction of movement

definitions.gloss: direction of travel; direction of movement
definitions.explanation: The direction in which something is moving or proceeding. Most commonly used for trains, vehicles, and other forms of transportation. Frequently seen on signs and in announcements.

examples.japanese: {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}に{向|む}かって{右側|みぎがわ}です。
examples.english: It's on the right side in the direction of travel.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{進行方向|しんこうほうこう}に{向|む}かって{座|すわ}りたい。
examples.english: I want to sit facing the direction the train is moving.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{進行方向|しんこうほうこう}が{変|か}わり、{関東|かんとう}に{直撃|ちょくげき}する{可能性|かのうせい}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: The typhoon's direction of travel changed, raising the possibility of a direct hit on the Kanto region.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun formed from {進行|しんこう} (progress, movement) + {方向|ほうこう} (direction). Very common in train travel — passengers often choose seats based on {進行方向|しんこうほうこう} (forward-facing) versus {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう} (backward-facing). Also used in weather reports for typhoons and weather fronts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}に{向|む}かって (facing the direction of travel)
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}{右側|みぎがわ}/{左側|ひだりがわ} (right/left side in the direction of travel)
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}が{変|か}わる (the direction of travel changes)
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}と{逆|ぎゃく} (opposite to the direction of travel)
